description: NaTi₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.92 Å) and three longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-35°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.54 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom.
